name: Companion navigation
body: Dean (2026-11-17): companion navigation, camera and animation are the main things now. The companion uses straight-line steering plus hand-placed `via` waypoints and got stuck on stairs. She can't climb, but must help the player bypass climbing sections, and she is an equal partner. Build a navigation mesh in the Nox engine and pathfinding on it, expose it to Nyx, and make the partner walk paths instead of straight lines. Keep the existing room tests passing.
